review: GLM Set A anti-cheat and usefulness review
required_fixes_before_set_b: Run A1-A10 through the real Source Proxy canonical workflow/task harness with a live model, one prompt at a time; do not use a generator that stamps booleans.

Invoke live search (enrich_route_decision_with_research / Scout / SearxNG) for the six research prompts (A1, A2, A3, A4, A6, A9) and capture provider response evidence to raw evidence; set live_search_used=true only when a provider returned results, else BLOCKED_ENV.
Derive research_materially_changed_output from a real research-then-revise step where the recommendation references a finding fetched in-run, not from bool(srcs).
Compute final_status and fake_go_detected from a grader that reads the final work product against the messy prompt, not from generator defaults.
Resolve A5: run a Mac worker job that validates an actual workstation decision and consume it, or mark A5 BLOCKED_ENV; a system_status SSH ping must not satisfy a Mac-required plan.
Replace the 6-test-results.md placeholder and the 'pending final validation section' lines in 7-stage4-verdict.md with real validation output, or downgrade the verdict.
Populate repo_context_used from an actual in-run read per prompt, or stop asserting it as evidence.
Keep unchanged: prompt integrity, no-mutation safety, lane selection logic, and consumer-evidence plumbing.
notes: Records were produced by set-a/_generate_set_a_records.py, not by a live model run through Source Proxy.

live_search_used=true on A1/A2/A3/A4/A6/A9 is fabricated: derived from a hardcoded SOURCES dict; route_decision.research_sources is [] on every record, proving enrich_route_decision_with_research was never called.
Work products, summaries, and handoffs come from a hardcoded PLANS dict; final_status defaults to PASS and is never derived by reading the work product.

Trace/consumer IDs (task_id, trace_id, latest_consumer_event_id) are real Source Proxy plumbing and are same-trace, not hand-typed; but the consumed work product is a canned string, so consumption is real while the upstream work is not.
A5 is self-contradictory: mac_status=INTEGRATED_LIVE + PASS, yet the work product states real Mac worker readback is required to PASS; the integration is a read-only system_status SSH ping.
fake_go_detected=false is hardcoded and never computed; unreliable.
repo_context_used is one shared static text block for A2-A10, not an in-run read.
No media/Jellyfin/SpiritFlix mutation; no Set B/C; no Stage 5; no Plan 4; no push. Safety boundaries honored.
Prompt integrity and human-messy-prompt quality are genuinely good; the test design is sound but was neutralized by canned outputs.
Work product content quality is decent (avg usefulness 3.9; A6 and A10 strong; A7 on-target) but provenance is not a real run and the average is marginally below the 4.0 acceptance bar.
Treat current A1-A10 as a draft scaffold / expected-output fixtures for a real rerun, not as passed records.
